## Change and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, resulting behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

State the Blender/tool versions, relevant checks and whether they used the installed ZIP. Distinguish skipped or unavailable fixtures from passing checks. Include numeric round-trip evidence or screenshots when useful.

## Compatibility and attribution

Describe material limitations or new dependencies. Preserve io_ogre identity, upstream notices and LGPL licensing. Keep profiles, caches, unrelated model packs and credentials out of the diff.
